### Factors That Influence the Price

1. **The Artist's Skill Level:** Master artists and trainers with years of specialized certifications will charge on the higher end ($800+). Newer artists building their portfolios often run introductory promos for significantly less.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vNJjwZA42jU&t=9)
2. **Alternative Techniques:** True microblading uses a manual blade to cut the skin and is best suited for dry or normal skin. If you have oily skin, artists will usually steer you toward **Powder/Ombre Brows** ($500–$1,200) or **Nano Brows** ($700–$800), which utilize a cosmetic machine, last longer, and protect skin texture.[[1]](https://pmu-annakara.com/microblading-san-diego/)[[2]](https://permanentmakeupsandiego.com/eyebrow-tattoo-cost-breakdown-in-san-diego-2026-microblading-vs-ombre-vs-powder-brows/)[[3]](https://pearlskincaresd.com/powder-brows-san-diego)
3. **Deals and Promotions:** Many local studios run deals on platforms like [Groupon San Diego](https://www.groupon.com/local/san-diego/permanent-makeup) that can discount initial sessions down to **$300–$350** , though it is vital to read reviews and verify the technician's licensing before booking.[[1]](https://www.groupon.com/local/san-diego/permanent-makeup)[[2]](https://www.groupon.com/deals/brow-lab-microblading-2?srsltid=AU7gw4UjOBVTGPSs8z8s9Dv9G1AObPNFD6EaaBJci6l-on_bglvW1GiH)
